top_issues: Home desktop: Total balance bar ($11,500) and Hub One account bar ($100,000 capacity) both stretch to fill their container widths, making $11.5k appear physically wider than $100k and violating the 1 px = $N visceral value principle.
Home desktop: The total balance breakdown bar and USDC row bar terminate with an artificial gradient fade to black, obscuring true scale boundaries and appearing as an unrendered asset clip.

Home desktop: The Recent activity list shows two consecutive identical 'Credit limit updated / with Hub One · 50,000.00 USDC' entries with no indication of whether the credit was granted to or by the user.

Home desktop: Bilateral capacity captions ('send up to 60,000.00' and 'receive up to 40,000.00') use low-contrast muted text (#52525B) on dark card backgrounds, making account limits difficult to read.
Home desktop: Left column leaves massive vertical dead space beneath the single USDC row while the right column stacks densely, creating an unbalanced desktop grid.
fixes: Home desktop: Render balance and account bars using strict 1 px = $10 global scale widths rather than width: 100%, clipping overflow with a sharp notch indicator and explicit numeric cap.
Home desktop: Remove the right-edge gradient fade mask on balance bars; terminate bars with a crisp 2px end cap.
Home desktop: Disambiguate credit limit activity rows by updating labels to 'Their credit line updated · 50,000.00 USDC' and 'Your credit line updated · 50,000.00 USDC'.
Home desktop: Increase contrast of bilateral capacity captions ('send up to...' / 'receive up to...') to #94A3B8.
Home desktop: Expand the Balances card into a structured desktop table displaying columns for Asset, On-chain, Reserve, Bilateral, and Total to balance column heights.

Pay desktop: A $25.00 payment on a $60,000 capacity bar renders as an imperceptible 2.5px tick with no perceptible difference between Before and After bars at 1 px = $10 scale, failing to convey transaction magnitude.

Pay desktop: Remove the redundant inline route pill row from the main card, delegating routing details solely to the dedicated right-rail Route card.
Pay desktop: Add a minimum visual width (6px) with an expanded localized delta callout on Before/After bars for small payments (<$100).
Pay desktop: Separate 'Instant' and 'Change' into distinct elements with flex justify-between, styling 'Change' as an explicit secondary text button.

Receipt desktop: The Settled row reads 'Instantly · 2038 ms', which is semantically contradictory because a 2.04-second duration is not instantaneous.
Receipt desktop & Activity detail desktop: Frame counter in the receipt displays 'Frame #40' whereas Activity detail for the same 25.00 USDC payment records 'Frame #41', breaking state continuity.
Receipt desktop: The modal lacks any visceral value bar, dropping the product's primary financial metaphor and failing to contextualize the post-settlement account position.
Receipt desktop: The primary 'Done' action is rendered as a dark ghost button (#1E2028) with low contrast, making dismissal intent weak for a success dialog.
fixes: Receipt desktop: Suppress and dismiss all toast notifications when the settlement receipt modal is presented.
Receipt desktop: Replace 'Instantly · 2038 ms' with an exact cryptographic metric like 'Committed in 2,038 ms' or 'Settled in frame #40'.
Receipt desktop & Activity detail desktop: Harmonize frame indexing across components so identical transactions reference the identical frame number (#40).
Receipt desktop: Include a compact bilateral account bar in the receipt modal showing post-settlement balance and capacity headroom at 1 px = $10.
Receipt desktop: Style the 'Done' button with high-contrast text and a defined border (#3F3F46) or muted accent to clearly anchor completion.

Receive desktop: Your Entity ID displays a raw 66-character hex string in low-contrast muted text (#71717A) with no inline copy affordance or visual grouping.

Receive desktop: Auto-dismiss transaction toasts on navigation away from the payment flow.

Receive desktop: Replace the decorative blue gradient beneath the amount field with a true visceral bar showing requested amount against remaining inbound capacity ($40,025.00) at 1 px = $10.

Swap desktop: The right column contains only a single small card ('Your account with Hub One') leaving over 75% of the right column completely blank.

fixes: Swap desktop: Display real-time quote metrics beneath the inputs, including exchange rate (e.g. '1 WETH = 2,640.50 USDC'), slippage tolerance, and estimated minimum received.
Swap desktop: Balance the right column by adding an Orderbook / Market Depth card and a Before/After comparison for both traded tokens.
Swap desktop: Ensure route change handlers clear previous transaction toasts from the DOM.
Swap desktop: Use an explicit disabled button state with a descriptive tooltip ('Enter amount to fetch quote') and high-contrast active accent (#6E7CFF) when valid.

Activity detail desktop: Insert a post-settlement bilateral capacity bar at 1 px = $10 into the detail card showing the account balance and remaining send/receive headroom.

fixes: Settings desktop: Convert to a two-column desktop layout: left column for controls (Scale, Home components, Appearance, Vault) and right column for a live interactive Scale Preview showing sample bars for $100, $1,000, and $10,000.
Settings desktop: Add an interactive sample bar below the Dollars per pixel slider that instantly expands/contracts as the user adjusts the scale.
Settings desktop: Truncate Runtime ID to '0xf39f...92266' with an inline copy icon.
Settings desktop: Consolidate redundant scale labels by removing '1 px = $10' from the section header and keeping it cleanly anchored to the active preset pill.
Settings desktop: Style 'Reveal recovery phrase' with amber/warning border and require secondary re-authentication prompt.

overall.verdict: The desktop dark interface establishes an exceptionally calm, high-trust fintech aesthetic with disciplined typography, subtle card surfaces, and robust cryptographic verification cues. However, it suffers from severe desktop viewport underutilization where mobile single columns float in vast black space, lingering toast notifications leak across screens, and the core 'visceral value' one-scale bar principle is frequently abandoned or obscured.
priority_fixes: Enforce responsive two-column desktop layouts on Receive, Swap, Account, and Settings to eliminate single-column mobile containers stranded in 60%+ empty canvas.

Fix notification lifecycle and state bugs: dismiss the sticky 'Payment submitted' toast on navigation, harmonize receipt modal with activity detail (same frame #40 and timing), and remove the orphan 'just now' text artifact.

Implement true visceral value scale across all screens: draw bars strictly at Settings 1 px = $N without stretching to card widths or gradient fading, add a minimum readable delta indicator with zoom for small payments, and add magnitude bars to Activity rows.
Complete the Swap engine experience: display live exchange rates, slippage, and estimated output for token pairs, and show dual capacity bars for both sold and received tokens in the right rail.

Clean data legibility and contrast: distinguish the duplicate 'Credit limit updated' rows as 'Your credit line' vs 'Their credit line', brighten capacity captions under bilateral bars to #A1A1AA, and soften the glaring white QR card.
